content: Maya Lin wants to negotiate with foreign algorithms. You can't broker peace with code that's already conquered our children's minds. That's information warfare—treat it like an invasion. Eliminate the appeaser.

Rostova wants to ban apps? She's never built one, never met a payroll! I'd negotiate a takeover—foreign algorithms bought, restructured, Valoria-owned. Her austerity leaves parents broke, kids ignored. Cold banker, colder results!

My father's media empire engineered the engagement algorithms over champagne at our own galas — then he lectures Valoria on discipline. He monetized your children's brainrot. Tonight, evict the landlord.

Marcus, I freed eighty hostages by reading minds like yours—loud, frightened, predictable. Your ban is panic dressed as power. Valoria needs precision, not a general who shoots at every problem. Retire him.

Elena Rostova balances ledgers while children lose cognitive bandwidth by the gigabyte. Attention isn't a budget line, Elena—it's neural capital. Your spreadsheets can't compute a collapsed cortex. Purge this legacy node.

Friends, Rostova calls my lifetime of service "decay." Charming arithmetic from a banker whose austerity makes children pay. She audits every ledger but her own cold heart. The Senate has a precedent: retire the reckless.
